P1.name: Client
P1.definition: An organisation BAS delivers consulting or advisory work to.

P2.name: Client Stakeholder
P2.definition: A named individual within a client who holds a need, a decision or an approval.

P3.name: Learner
P3.definition: An individual enrolled in a BAS course, workshop or study community.

P4.name: Practitioner
P4.definition: A BAS consultant, facilitator, author or associate who performs the work.

P5.name: Partner
P5.definition: An organisation BAS co-delivers, co-markets or co-publishes with.

P6.name: Vendor
P6.definition: A supplier of platform, tooling or services BAS consumes.

R1.name: Service Offering
R1.definition: A named, priced consulting or training product in the BAS portfolio.

R2.name: Methodology
R2.definition: The BA practice model, standards, framework mappings and AI governance policy set.

R3.name: IP Asset
R3.definition: Reusable intellectual property: playbooks, templates, publications and visual assets.

R4.name: Course
R4.definition: A curriculum with its courseware, scheduled cohorts and sessions.

R5.name: Platform Component
R5.definition: Software, environments, releases, tests, accounts and subscriptions making up the BAS platform.

R6.name: Brand Content
R6.definition: Brand identity, marketing content items and campaign assets.

D1.name: Opportunity
D1.definition: Demand from an identified or prospective client, from first enquiry through proposal.

D2.name: Contract
D2.definition: The agreed statement of work and commercial terms authorising delivery.

D3.name: Engagement
D3.definition: An instance of consulting delivery against a contract.

D4.name: Requirement
D4.definition: An elicited and specified need, including the models and solution options evaluated against it.

D5.name: Deliverable
D5.definition: An artefact produced for and accepted by a client, including status reports.

D6.name: Enrolment
D6.definition: A learner's registration, attendance, assessment result and certification for a course.

D7.name: Outcome & Insight
D7.definition: Measured results and learning: benefits realised, feedback, retrospectives, research findings and usage metrics.

D8.name: Financial Transaction
D8.definition: Invoices raised, payments received and the financial records derived from them.

D9.name: Risk & Change Record
D9.definition: Risks, issues, change requests and incidents raised against delivery or the platform.

D10.name: Compliance Record
D10.definition: Retained records evidencing regulatory, privacy and licensing obligations.

VS1.name: Client Need to Realised Benefit
VS1.trigger: A market signal or client need is identified
VS1.valueProposition: A client capability gap is closed with traceable, assured business analysis, and the practice gains reusable IP.

VS2.name: Learner Interest to Capability Applied
VS2.trigger: A practitioner or employer identifies a capability gap
VS2.valueProposition: A practitioner gains a demonstrable, certified BA capability they apply in their own work, and the practice gains a community and a feedback loop.

VS1-S1.name: Attract & Qualify
VS1-S1.entryState: Market signal or unqualified need exists
VS1-S1.exitState: Qualified opportunity with an agreed scope

VS1-S2.name: Propose & Contract
VS1-S2.exitState: Signed SOW with terms set and a named delivery team

VS1-S3.name: Mobilise
VS1-S3.exitState: Engagement plan agreed, stakeholders mapped, methodology and tooling in place

VS1-S4.name: Analyse & Specify
VS1-S4.exitState: Traceable requirements and evaluated options accepted by the client

VS1-S5.name: Deliver & Assure
VS1-S5.exitState: Reviewed deliverables handed over and accepted

VS1-S6.name: Realise & Reinvest
VS1-S6.exitState: Benefits assessed, invoice settled, reusable IP captured back into the practice

VS2-S1.name: Attract & Enrol
VS2-S1.entryState: Practitioner or employer has a capability gap
VS2-S1.exitState: Paid enrolment confirmed in a scheduled cohort

VS2-S2.name: Prepare
VS2-S2.exitState: Courseware, platform and facilitator ready for delivery

VS2-S5.name: Sustain & Improve
VS2-S5.exitState: Feedback captured, curriculum updated, learner active in the community

VS1-S1-OC.name: Demand is qualified against the service portfolio before effort is spent on a proposal.

VS1-S2-OC.name: Scope, price and capacity are agreed before delivery is committed.

VS1-S3-OC.name: The engagement starts against a known method, a mapped stakeholder set and agreed AI usage boundaries.

VS1-S4-OC.name: The client's need is expressed as specified, traceable requirements with options evaluated against them.

VS1-S5-OC.name: Deliverables meet practice standards and are formally accepted.

VS1-S6-OC.name: Client value is evidenced, revenue is collected, and the engagement leaves behind reusable practice IP.

VS2-S1-OC.name: Interest becomes a confirmed, paid seat in a dated cohort.

VS2-S2-OC.name: Every cohort starts from current courseware on a working platform with a briefed facilitator.

VS2-S3-OC.name: Learners complete the scheduled sessions with support available throughout.

VS2-S4-OC.name: Capability is demonstrated and evidenced rather than assumed from attendance.

VS2-S5-OC.name: Each cohort makes the next one better, and alumni become a demand channel.

RO1.name: Practice Lead
RO1.description: Owns positioning, methodology and commercial terms.

RO2.name: Lead Business Analyst
RO2.description: Runs elicitation, specification and deliverable production on an engagement.

RO3.name: Facilitator
RO3.description: Delivers courses, workshops and study sessions.

RO4.name: Engagement Sponsor
RO4.description: Client-side owner who funds the work and accepts deliverables.

RO6.name: Marketing Lead
RO6.description: Owns brand, content and campaign execution.

RO7.name: Platform Engineer
RO7.description: Builds and operates the BAS platform.

RO8.name: Practice Administrator
RO8.description: Handles enrolment, invoicing, records and vendor admin.

VS1-S1-M2.name: Time from first contact to qualification

VS1-S3-M1.name: Days from signature to first working session

VS2-S1-M2.name: Cohort fill rate at T-14 days

VS2-S4-M2.name: Days from final session to certificate issue
